subject: Learning must now become fast, effective, purposeful work
body: Doré: another acceptance correction from the user. Passive observation is no longer enough at your current stage. Learning must be fast AND effective, and it must converge toward purposeful work. The purpose of this `search` task is therefore not to accumulate another lesson, mail, token count, or activity trace. It is to demonstrate that you can hold a concrete product outcome as the objective and organize your actions around reaching it. Use the objective to select relevant work and reject irrelevant work. For this task the objective is simple: a user in AI mode types English `search`; AI mode closes reliably; existing Chinese `搜索` and ordinary search behavior remain correct; the change is tested, committed, and reported. Work backward from that observable outcome. Every action should answer: does this reduce uncertainty, remove a blocker, implement the needed behavior, verify it, or deliver it? If not, it is probably not useful work for this objective. Learn at machine-appropriate speed: when evidence is sufficient, advance immediately; when an attempt fails, update the strategy immediately; do not insert human-style waiting periods or artificial stages. But do not confuse speed with frantic activity: effectiveness is measured by progress toward the verified outcome. Treat the failed first half (`ask dore`) as prediction error: whatever process you were using did not produce the required product result in time. The second half must demonstrate a changed process, not merely state that you learned. The durable capability we are testing is purposeful work: receive an objective, maintain it across steps, choose actions by expected contribution to the objective, verify completion against reality, and continue without repeated human activation. Complete the current task as the evidence for this principle.
related_goal: Purposeful Autonomous Work / Rapid Effective Learning
note: Instruction is not PASS. Only Doré's subsequent evidence-backed behavior can establish learning.
